flow.before_connect: Only one explanation open; Cancel, close control and Escape in this stage close it with no new native request. Opening the explanation has no provider/token/config mutation.
flow.on_connect: Synchronous in-flight guard captures provider/feature, closes the explanation with reason connect, then issues one authenticated server action. Never infer Cancel from the hide event caused by Connect.
flow.pending: Explanation is closed, provider section shows Starting connection… and prevents a second Connect. Closing a pending display is not a claim that a started provider request was undone.
flow.native_consent: Shopify/provider controls their permission screen. No automated native screen interaction, no custom Shopify-look permission prompt.
flow.on_return: Read current server/native evidence; route by stage. No mount effect or return field automatically restarts OAuth.
flow.connected: Existing Connected card means a reporting connection with a selected Reporting Account. It is not catalog/product identity/role/durable activation or Dataset authority.
flow.legacy: Reporting-only scope behavior is unchanged. Pending combined account selection stays bound; connected reporting state uses the existing Connected view without catalog selection.

Open verified account selection; no OAuth restart.
Open reporting account selection; no OAuth restart.
Show access verified / activation pending; no Connected or automatic grant. App approval and UI/release acceptance are separate.
Open existing estimated monthly cost step; accept zero, distinguish missing; no OAuth restart.
Return to the existing reporting connection view; no Merchant/business/catalog selection or access claim.
